capacity_gross_kwh.notes: 78.1 kWh nominal, LG 5L NMC (EV Database); Wikipedia lists 78.1 kWh for Premium RWD/AWD. EV Database Highland LR RWD page (Oct 2024-Oct 2025).

capacity_usable_kwh.notes: 75.0 kWh usable (EV Database estimate); KBB US 2026 Premium/Performance also 75 kWh. EV Database Highland LR RWD page (Oct 2024-Oct 2025).

chemistry.notes: NMC (LG 5L cells) per EV Database; Wikipedia: Shanghai cells are LG NMC. A Fremont-built car could carry Panasonic NCA cells instead; not verified. EV Database Highland LR RWD page (Oct 2024-Oct 2025).

nominal_voltage_class.notes: 357 V nominal, 400 V architecture. EV Database Highland LR RWD page (Oct 2024-Oct 2025).

preconditioning.notes: Estimated: Tesla's release note (2020.24.6.4, Model S/3/X/Y) says the car preconditions its battery when navigating to a fast charger; this is a software feature delivered to the whole Model 3 line (2024-2025 LR RWD). Page mentions no manual battery-warming control. A manual control was neither found nor ruled out: Tesla's owner's manual pages were blocked (403) and scheduled-departure preconditioning in search excerpts is cabin-oriented.

dc_max_kw.notes: 250 kW (EV Database; InsideEVs Highland article: Long Range AWD 250 kW, unchanged from before; Wikipedia Premium RWD 250 kW). EV Database Highland LR RWD page (Oct 2024-Oct 2025).
